title: Miller-Marley School of Dance and Voice — Dance Classes in Overland Park, KS
description: 64-year-old Overland Park dance school founded by Kansas City tap icon Shirley Marley. Tap, jazz, ballet, hip hop, musical theatre and private voice for all ages.

blocks.heading: 64 years of inspiring passion, nurturing talent, creating stars
blocks.subheading: Shirley Marley has taught tap, jazz, ballet and musical theatre in Overland Park since the early 1960s — training Broadway performers and a Radio City Rockette along the way.

badge.small: Years teaching dance in Overland Park

items.title: Tap
items.desc: Shirley Marley's own specialty — tap instruction from a Kansas City tap icon.

items.title: Ballet
items.desc: Through Miller Marley Youth Ballet and Youth Ballet 2, the studio's own student ballet companies.

items.title: Musical Theatre
items.desc: Performing companies by grade band, from TiniTainers (K–2) through Entertainers (7th–high school).

blocks.heading: What students have gone on to do

items.text: I could not have made it to be a Radio City Rockette without Shirley Marley.

blocks.heading: Enroll for 2026–2027
blocks.text: Classes run fall through spring. Call the studio to ask about openings and schedule a visit.
